summaries.zh: A balance & cost widget for the DSH web GUI: a persistent sidebar footer card shows the DeepSeek account balance, a remaining-ratio bar and today's costs; clicking opens a four-tier cost breakdown (last prompt / this session / today-this-project / today-all) with term explanations and a one-click top-up link. Zero external dependencies, works on Node 24.
